Hirogaru Beni Fuku Mochi (Red) 红福麻糬（红）
items.description:
A new kind of delicious treat featuring silky-smooth
 mochi, melt-in-your-mouth cream, and a perfect balance
 of mildly sweet tsubuan (chunky red bean paste) and
 purple sweet potato paste.
 Best enjoyed chilled for a refreshing and indulgent
 experience.

items.name: Hirogaru Yume Fuku Mochi (White) 梦福麻糬（白）
items.description:
These dumplings are made with dough kneaded
 with yomogi (Japanese mugwort), featuring a
 refreshing sweetness and a distinctive
 aromatic fragrance of yomogi.

items.name: Matcha Daifuku (Green) 抹茶大福（绿）
items.description:
A perfect harmony of elegant matcha
 aroma and light, creamy smoothness.

items.name: Strawberry Daifuku with Smooth Red Bean Paste (Red) 草莓红豆沙大福（红）
items.description:
A soft and chewy mochi filled with smooth whipped
 cream and silky red bean paste (koshian).
 The sweet and tangy flavor of strawberries pairs
 perfectly, creating a deliciously balanced treat.

items.name: Strawberry Daifuku with Chunky Red Bean Paste (White) 草莓红豆粒大福（白）
items.description:
A soft and chewy mochi filled with smooth
 whipped cream and sweet red bean paste.
 Perfectly complemented by the sweet and tangy flavor
 of strawberries, this delightful treat offers a
 harmonious balance of textures and tastes.

items.name: Strawberry Daifuku with Matcha (Green) 草莓抹茶大福（绿）
items.description:
A soft and chewy mochi filled with fluffy whipped
 cream and smooth matcha (green tea) bean paste.
 The sweet and tangy flavor of strawberries pairs
 perfectly, creating a refreshing and balanced treat.

items.name: Shio Mame Daifuku 盐豆大福
items.description:
Made with red peas (aka-endo), this treat
 offers a well-balanced blend of sweet and
 savory flavors.
 Perfect for those who prefer something less
 sweet.

items.name: Yomogi Daifuku 艾草大福
items.description:
This fragrant treat is made with yomogi
 (Japanese mugwort) kneaded into the dough.
 The rich aroma of yomogi fills your mouth the
 moment you take a bite, gently rising through
 your nose for a truly immersive experience.

items.name: Nama Chocolate Daifuku 生巧大福
Strawberry Daifuku with Nama Chocolate 草莓生巧大福
Hanami Dango (Made with Domestic Rice Flour) 三色团子
items.description:
The pink represents cherry blossoms, the white
 symbolizes snow, and the green reflects fresh
 spring leaves.
 These softly sweet dango feature yomogi
 (Japanese mugwort) flavor in the green pieces.

items.name: Yomogi Dango (Made with Domestic Rice Flour) 艾草团子
items.description:
These dumplings are made with dough kneaded
 with yomogi (Japanese mugwort), featuring a
 refreshing sweetness and a distinctive
 aromatic fragrance of yomogi.

items.name: Amaou Strawberry Dango 栃木产草莓团子
items.description:
Topped with a luxurious strawberry paste made from the
 Amaou brand—a premium variety named for its qualities:
 “Red,” “Round,” “Big,” and “Delicious.”
 Enjoy the rich, authentic flavor of Amaou strawberries
 in every bite.

items.name: Mitsu-iri Dango yon-ka dama (Made with Domestic Rice Flour) 甜酱油团子
items.description:
Our most popular wagashi (Japanese sweet)!
 Please enjoy our signature mitarashi dango,
 featuring the perfect balance of sweet and
 savory with a special soy sauce and sugar
 glaze.

items.name: Isobe Dango 福冈产海苔团子
items.description:
This traditional wagashi features a chewy rice cake
 wrapped in seaweed and coated with a savory soy sauce
 glaze.
 The rich aroma of soy sauce and roasted nori makes it an
 appetizing treat, especially for those who prefer less
 sweetness.

items.name: Chilled Mitarashi Dango with Sweet Red Bean Filling 红豆馅甜酱油团子
items.description:
Our all-time No.1 best-seller!
 This beloved mitarashi dango is filled with smooth
 koshian (sweet red bean paste), offering a perfect
 balance of sweet soy glaze and delicate bean flavor.
 Made with kuzumochi, it stays soft even when chilled and
 has a delightfully smooth texture.

items.name: Abekawa Dango (Made with Domestic Rice Flour) 安倍川团子
items.description:
These bite-sized mitarashi dango can be easily
 pulled apart, making them perfect for sharing.
 Each piece is just the right size for children,
 and great for enjoying with family or friends!

items.name: Kinako Ohagi (with Sweet Red Bean Filling)   Loos 黄豆粉糯米团
items.description:
This ohagi features a soft and chewy texture,
 filled with sweet red bean paste (tsubuan) and
 coated in roasted soybean flour (kinako).
 The gentle sweetness of the beans and the nutty aroma of
 kinako create a truly comforting harmony of flavors.

items.name: Goma Ohagi   Loose 芝麻糯米团
items.description:
This ohagi features a delightfully soft and chewy
 texture, paired with the gentle sweetness of chunky red
 bean paste (tsubuan) and the rich, nutty flavor of
 sesame.
 A perfectly balanced harmony of traditional Japanese
 flavors.

items.name: Sakura Mochi (Individually Wrapped) 樱花糯米团
items.description:
This is a Kansai-style sakura mochi made with
 domyoji (glutinous rice granules).
 Its slightly coarse, chewy texture is similar
 to ohagi, and the delicate aroma of salted
 cherry leaves fills your mouth with each bite.

items.name: Chewy Milk 牛奶大福
items.description:
It has a sweetened
condensed milk cream
filling

items.name: Chewy Pudding 布丁大福
items.description:
It has a custard cream
filling

items.name: Cream-filled Warabi Mochi 奶心蕨饼
items.description: Cream-filled Warabi Mochi

Sweet Potato Dango 北海道产甜署团子
items.description:
A delightful fusion of sweet potato and butter,
 capturing the classic flavor of a Western-style sweet
 potato dessert.
 With butter blended into the red bean paste, it’s a
 unique treat that tastes just like sweet potato—even
 though it’s made with anko.

items.name: Edamame Paste Dango 青豆团子
items.description:
A gentle sweetness that highlights the natural
 aroma and flavor of edamame.
 The rich, lingering taste of edamame creates
 an addictive, delightful experience.

items.name: Aohagi (Individually Wrapped 豆沙糯米团
items.description:
This ohagi features a soft and chewy texture,
 filled with gently sweet tsubuan (chunky red
 bean paste) that melts in your mouth.
 A classic Japanese treat that never goes out
 of style.
